span.p:
No attestation blob (Open Mode), or MarkUntrusted:
invalid blob under a binary-hash policy, 3 hard challenge failures,
SIP/Secure Boot off, hash drift, MDM posture mismatch, chunk violation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Registration blob signed by the SE P-256 key
verifyProviderAttestation → SetAttested(true, TrustSelfSigned)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
challengeLoop every DefaultChallengeInterval = 5m
ChallengeResponseTimeout = 30s · routable while LastChallengeVerified ≤ 16m old

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MDM SecurityInfo cross-check, scheduled per connection
SIP on · SecureBootLevel == full · agrees with the SE blob
recordTrustReuse → GrantHardwareEvidenceAtEpochIfNotUntrusted

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
mda_verified — Apple DevicePropertiesAttestation chain
SetMDAProofIfHardwareBound (hardware first)

span.p:
code_attested — APNs / resume code-identity challenge
GrantProcessCodeAttested (same K + same APNs token)

status · private-only · trust floor · RuntimeVerified ·
providerSupportsPrivateTextLocked · challenge ≤ 16m
